chunks: From Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) who said: It is not permissible for the one praying to pray in congregation unless there is an Imam for him, or he himself is the Imam.
And he does not pray alone unless he follows an Imam.
ai.seo_question: What is the condition for a person to pray in congregation according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: In *Kamal al-Din*, Shaykh al-Saduq records Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifying that valid congregational prayer requires either following a designated Imam or being the Imam oneself, thereby establishing the necessity of leadership (*Imamah*) in worship. This hadith underscores the Shia theological principle that the validity of individual and communal acts of devotion is intrinsically linked to the authority of the Imam, reflecting the continuity of divine guidance through the Ahl al-Bayt.
